name: Chucho
source:
Major: Economy

This rather eccentric raccoon is found on a 99% of the time either watching anime or playing videogames. Always ready for anything, he loves RPGs and epic animes the most. In a ratio of 1:4, his statements can be either creepy or nonsensical. His mostly-all-cases neutral face doens't show which. His favorite drink: CitFruit.

[From [url=http://corruptpolygons.com/]Corrupt Polygons[/url]]
